messages:
Nadia P: FYI — Customer Atlas asked for per-tenant regional isolation, proof of key residency, and a routing policy that guarantees no cross-region artifact hydration. they want a pilot before EOY. can we scope?
Ethan (Arch): noted. we should split requirements: policy surface, artifact residency enforcement, runtime cache boundaries, and commercial SLA. propose a small spec doc + dependency table.
Ravi - Eng: quick thought: runtime can tag requests with tenant_residency and artifact_lock attributes. sample predicate: 
```json
{"match": {"region": "us-west-1", "tenant_residency": "us"}, "route_to": "dedicated-pool-us", "enforce": ["artifact_lock", "kms_in_region"] }
```
Iris - Security: important: KMS design must surface HSM requirement and rotate keys per-tenant. auditability: 90-day immutable audit log for pilot.
Tomas (Sales): Atlas is willing to pay for a dedicated slice if we can commit to encrypted-in-region keys and an SLA extension. timeline they asked for: 12 weeks.
Nadia P: can eng validate feasibility (cache isolation + artifact locking) in a 1-week spike? we also need an ops rollback plan.
pm-bot: New doc placeholder created -> /docs/product/tenant-residency-spike (internal) :file_folder:
Ethan (Arch): I'll draft the dependency table. rows: artifact-storage-policy, runtime-cache-segmentation, kms-per-region, network-peering, telemetry/audit, rollout-automation. each row should have owner + risk level.
Ravi - Eng: spike tasks: 1) prototype tagging & predicate (3d) 2) runtime guardrail to refuse cross-region KV warm (4d) 3) simulate artifact-residency checks in catalog + UI flag (2d). total ~2 weeks to have realistic demo.
Iris - Security: add a compliance checklist: encryption-at-rest keys by region, audit retention, penetration test window, SLAs for key access. will need security sign-off for pilot.
Tomas (Sales): sounds good. I can push pilot agreement and defer full audit to phase 2. customer prefers incremental launches.
Ethan (Arch): launching gates proposal: - spike validated (runtime + catalog flags demo) - dependency table with owners and mitigation - pilot SLA + billing agreed - security checklist signed for pilot - fallback flow: if dedicated pool unavailable, route to approved hosted lane with consent.
deploy-bot: Deploy preview created -> routing-spike/preview-2222224321 :white_check_mark:
Nadia P: owners: Ethan -> dep table + gating, Ravi -> spike + demo, Iris -> security checklist + signoff, Tomas -> pilot commercial. next sync Tue 9am. I'll notify Atlas of proposed cadence. :spiral_calendar:
